# Pin map (generated by `tools/pin_map.py` from `kicad/sylvia-node.net`)

Firmware constants live in `firmware/components/board/include/board.h`; this script fails if they disagree.

## ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 (U1)
RTC = usable as a deep-sleep wake source / held level.

| Pad | Pin | RTC | Net | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | GND |  | `GND` |  |
| 2 | 3V3 |  | `3V3` |  |
| 3 | EN |  | `ESP_EN` | reset: 10k + 1 µF + RESET button |
| 4 | IO4 | ✓ | `I2C0_SDA` | I2C0 SDA, 100 kHz (LMP91000 max) |
| 5 | IO5 | ✓ | `I2C0_SCL` | I2C0 SCL |
| 6 | IO6 | ✓ | `I2C1_SDA` | I2C1 SDA (SEN66 cable), 100 kHz |
| 7 | IO7 | ✓ | `I2C1_SCL` | I2C1 SCL |
| 8 | IO15 | ✓ | `BUZZER` | buzzer PWM 2.7 kHz (DNP) |
| 9 | IO16 | ✓ | `LORA_RST` | RAK3172 NRST (open-drain) |
| 10 | IO17 | ✓ | `LORA_TX` | UART1 TX → RAK3172 UART2 RX (AT, 115200) |
| 11 | IO18 | ✓ | `LORA_RX` | UART1 RX ← RAK3172 UART2 TX |
| 12 | IO8 | ✓ | `EN_SEN` | LS1 ON: SEN66 rail (hold during deep sleep) |
| 13 | USB_D- |  | `USB_D-` | native USB (flash, console) |
| 14 | USB_D+ |  | `USB_D+` | native USB |
| 15 | IO3 | ✓ | `NC` | strapping (JTAG source): not used |
| 16 | IO46 |  | `NC` | strapping: not used |
| 17 | IO9 | ✓ | `EN_ALT` | LS2 ON: alternates rail |
| 18 | IO10 | ✓ | `CHG_INHIBIT` | charge inhibit (high = BQ24650 off) |
| 19 | IO11 | ✓ | `FG_ALRT` | MAX17048 ALRT (open-drain): ext1 wake |
| 20 | IO12 | ✓ | `CHG_STAT1` | BQ24650 STAT1 (low = charging) |
| 21 | IO13 | ✓ | `CHG_STAT2` | BQ24650 STAT2 (low = done) |
| 22 | IO14 | ✓ | `LED` | status LED |
| 23 | IO21 | ✓ | `TAMPER` | tamper pads (100k pull-up, closed = low): ext1 wake |
| 24 | IO47 |  | `ADC_RDY` | ADS1115 ALERT/RDY |
| 25 | IO48 |  | `IO48_SPARE` | spare → test point |
| 26 | IO45 |  | `NC` | strapping (VDD_SPI voltage): must stay low/floating |
| 27 | IO0 | ✓ | `ESP_BOOT` | BOOT button (strapping: low at reset = download mode) |
| 28 | IO35 |  | `NC` | octal PSRAM: NEVER use |

| 30 | IO37 |  | `NC` | octal PSRAM: NEVER use |
| 31 | IO38 |  | `VBUS_DET` | VBUS detect (divider, 2.5 V) |
| 32 | IO39 |  | `LORA_BOOT0` | RAK3172 BOOT0 (high = bootloader) |
| 33 | IO40 |  | `PM_SET` | PMSA003I SET (alt) |
| 34 | IO41 |  | `ALT_UART_RX` | UART2 RX ← ZE07-CO TXD (alt) |
| 35 | IO42 |  | `ALT_UART_TX` | UART2 TX → ZE07-CO RXD (alt) |
| 36 | RXD0 |  | `UART0_RX` | UART0 RX ← J6 |
| 37 | TXD0 |  | `UART0_TX` | UART0 TX → J6 debug header |
| 38 | IO2 | ✓ | `ZE07_ADC_ESP` | ADC1_CH1: ZE07-CO DAC (alt, 0 Ω DNP) |

| 41 | GND |  | `GND` |  |
